_note: A ROADBOOK season (docs/ROADBOOK.md). chapters open as the season's points reach unlockAt (points come from challenges and Expedition stages: they're never spent); a chapter's milestone pays its tokens once all its challenges' points are earned. A challenge's goal: event (what the game reports), where (what the event must say: a value or a list of values), then count (that many events), sum (that field added up to target), unique (that many different values of that field) or streak (that many in a row: an event that doesn't match where starts it again). Challenges count all season, even in a chapter still closed: they complete when it opens. start: "beta_open" (the day sign-ups open to everyone: the admin page's Launch tab) or a date; until then only admins and editors see it, to test it.
